audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of both Sebastian motorcycle scenes, Willy’s ore-panning scene, and both branches of Linus’s friendship and housing scene. Every spoken line, player response, gender branch, city and road image, motorcycle term, ore-panning instruction, housing offer, boundary statement, friendship sentiment, and berry image was reviewed in full event context. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, forks and response IDs, item reward, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Mountain records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
